acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By accessing and using Vozzify, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following terms and conditions of use. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you must not use our service.

service.title: Description of the Service
service.body: Vozzify is a platform that helps users discover the vocal notes of songs. Our service provides music analysis and note visualization tools for educational and entertainment purposes. The source code is open source, released under the MIT License, and is available at <repository>{repositoryUrl}</repository>. The license covers only the source code; it grants no rights over the music or other third-party content shown on the site.

copyright.title: Music Content and Copyright
copyright.body: Music playback on Vozzify follows the policy below:

items.directPlayback: Direct playback on the site only when: (i) the musical work allows playback or streaming under the applicable licenses; or (ii) Vozzify has validly acquired or licensed the rights needed to play the work internally on our domain.
items.otherCases: All other cases: the song is played exclusively through the official YouTube player, via the official YouTube API. In these cases, the content is served and controlled by YouTube, and any copyright matters are governed by YouTube's Terms of Service and policies.
items.noModification: We do not modify, redistribute or resell music content; all copyrights and related rights remain with their respective holders.
items.noStorage: We do not upload or store recordings on our servers, except where covered by a valid license that authorizes us to play them internally as described above.
items.analysisTool: Vozzify is a tool for analyzing and visualizing music data and complies with applicable copyright law.

copyright.artistRemoval: If you are an artist whose music is on Vozzify and you do not want it to be available here, just contact us at <email>{address}</email>.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.body: By using Vozzify, you agree to:

items.lawfulUse: Use the service only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these Terms
items.noIntrusion: Not attempt to access restricted areas of the system or reverse engineer it
items.noOverload: Not use the service in a way that could damage, disable or overload our infrastructure
items.noDataCollection: Not collect or store other users' personal data without consent
items.respectRights: Respect the copyrights and intellectual property of third parties

accounts.title: User Accounts
accounts.body: You are responsible for keeping your account and password confidential. You agree to accept responsibility for all activity that occurs under your account. We reserve the right to terminate accounts and to remove or edit content at our sole discretion.

privacy.title: Privacy and Data Protection
privacy.body: We take your privacy seriously. We collect and process personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the LGPD (Brazil's General Data Protection Law). The data we collect is used exclusively to provide and improve our services. When you create an account, we also store campaign details from your first and most recent visits, such as UTM parameters, advertising click IDs, the referrer and the landing page, to understand which campaigns bring new users. This information is stored in your account; we do not use a cookie for this purpose.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: Vozzify is provided “as is” and “as available”. We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted, secure or error-free. In no event will we be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages resulting from the use of, or inability to use, our service.

accuracy.title: Accuracy of Information
accuracy.body: Although we strive to provide accurate music analysis, we do not guarantee the complete accuracy of the detected notes. The analyses are based on automated algorithms and should be used as an educational reference. We are not responsible for specific interpretations or uses of the information provided.

serviceChanges.title: Changes to the Service
serviceChanges.body: We reserve the right to modify or discontinue, temporarily or permanently, the service (or any part of it) with or without prior notice. We will not be liable to you or to any third party for any modification, suspension or discontinuation of the service.

termsChanges.title: Changes to the Terms

We have no control over the content, privacy policies or practices of those sites and assume no responsibility for them. We recommend that you read the terms and privacy policies of any third-party site you visit.

governingLaw.title: Governing Law

notefinderNotice.description: A new name, a new look, and the same passion for singing. The features you already used on Notefinder remain free.

notefinder.metaDescription: Understand the move from Notefinder to Vozzify: free features, your account, and what changes for your singing practice.
notefinder.title: Notefinder is now Vozzify
notefinder.intro: We are rebuilding Notefinder as Vozzify, with a refreshed design and a foundation for new ways to practice singing. Here is what this change means for you.

pricing.title: Is Notefinder paid now?
pricing.answer: No. The features that already existed on Notefinder remain free on Vozzify. New features may be offered as part of paid plans, but you do not need a subscription to keep using the existing free features.

why.title: Why change to Vozzify?
why.answer: Vozzify is the next chapter of Notefinder. We are rebuilding the app to improve the experience and make room for new singing practice tools, while keeping the purpose you know: helping you see and practice vocal notes in songs.

account.title: Do I need a new account?
account.answer: No. Your Notefinder account and your saved personal data carry over to Vozzify. Keep using your existing login details and username.

links.title: Will my old links still work?
links.answer: Yes. Public Notefinder links will take you to their equivalent pages on Vozzify. You can keep using links to songs, artists, albums, and profiles.

catalog.title: What happens to the songs and their notes?
catalog.answer: The catalog is being processed again for Vozzify. Songs and their note analysis may be updated as part of this work, so some results can differ from what you saw on Notefinder.

notice.title: Will I see this announcement every time?
notice.answer: Once you close the announcement, this browser remembers your choice. It will stay hidden even if you open another link with the announcement parameter. You may see it again on a different browser or device, or after clearing this site’s stored data. This page remains available whenever you want to read it again.
